- I added `isUpdating` state and replaced the plain "update" button with an arrow icon that rotates during updates, matching the iPhone behavior.

You can find the change in:
```424:431:/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift
@ViewBuilder
private func updateButton() -> some View {
    // Button to manually update device location
    Button {
        withAnimation {
            isUpdating = true
        }
        Task {
            await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: true)
            withAnimation {
                isUpdating = false
            }
        }
    } label: {
        Image(systemName: "arrow.clockwise")
            .symbolEffect(.rotate.clockwise.byLayer, options: .nonRepeating, isActive: isUpdating)
    }
}
```

- Also added the new state:
```45:47:/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift

@State private var isUpdating = false // Controls update button animation state
```
